files.description: b(10) EHI Export attestation document with export instructions for single-patient and bulk export. Describes C-CDA 2.2 as the export format. Dated 2023-11-07, version 3.2.00.3.
Lists FHIR API service-base-url endpoints for 7 Cyfluent EHR facilities (AKMD, HBSH, HUMFA, PGP, PPEET, RCLAYTON, STEIN) and links to SwaggerHub API documentation.
IIS directory listing of the CURES documentation folder. Shows b10 attestation doc, service endpoints doc, and Real World Test Plan/Results directories (2022-2026).

OpenAPI/Swagger 2.0 spec for Cyfluent's Provider Portal API v3.3. Documents FHIR, oData, Security, and REST endpoints including C-CDA pull, file retrieval, prescription management, and order management.

ZIP containing OdataMetadata.xml (EDMX schema of 296 entity types, 3159 properties) and OdataService.xml (service document listing all OData entity sets). Referenced in SwaggerHub oData documentation.

OData EDMX metadata — the full CfChartOpModel database schema with 296 entity types, 3159 properties, 876 navigation properties, and 438 associations. Extracted from Desktop.zip. Effectively a complete data dictionary.
OData service document listing all 296 entity set collection endpoints. Extracted from Desktop.zip.

Full C# API client solution (oData example) with NuGet packages, CDA extraction code, and auto-generated OData service references. Referenced in SwaggerHub Security documentation. Contains Program.cs demonstrating patient data extraction workflow.

C# source code demonstrating CDA extraction: logs in via API, queries patients with encounters via oData, pulls C-CDA per patient, and queries individual data tables (allergies, problems, medications, vitals, prescriptions, care plans, goals, implantable devices, etc.).
Full-page screenshot of the Cyfluent ONC Certified Health IT page showing certification announcement, b(10) attestation text, and documentation links.
Screenshot of Cyfluent's SwaggerHub API documentation page showing FHIR, Security, oData, and REST endpoint sections.
Bun TypeScript script that parses OdataMetadata.xml into queryable JSON. Extracts entity types, properties, navigation properties, associations, and entity sets.
Full parsed OData schema in JSON: 296 entity types with all properties (types, nullability, max lengths), 876 navigation properties, and 438 associations with referential constraints.
Summary JSON with entity type names, property counts, category classifications (patient, encounter, orders, code-sets, facility-config, etc.), and key properties.
Enrichment documentation: run command, input/output descriptions, schema statistics, category breakdown, and known limitations.
